issues.reason: Core patterns states a stated restriction or qualifier is never silently dropped ('carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap'), and the parse drops the numeral 'one' while keeping the claim, widening 'holds one lantern' to the bare existential 'holds a lantern'.

gaps_confirmed: a singular cardinal on an argument NP ('one lantern'): Cardinality is defined only over plural group witnesses, and the single place a singular count is mentioned (the 'there is only one book' note under Focus particles, which says to emit the exact Cardinality) does not say what bears it
defect_summary: The compliant form keeps all six emitted atoms and adds the stated count for 'one' — either (Cardinality sk_lantern_1 1) on the witness or a singleton group (GroupOf sk_group_1 lantern) (Cardinality sk_group_1 1) filling the Theme — but the instruction set licenses the count atom without fixing its bearer for a singular NP, so no fully licensed form exists (the confirmed gap).
notes: Everything else is correct: the name/kind split for 'the Sunken Cove' (capitalized run exceeding the bare class word), Agent on the stative transitive 'holds' per the 'tank holds forty litres' case, Theme on the unchanged object, and no status atom on the bare simple present.
